Account summary: Halcyon is the operations arm for a large European grid operator. Strong mandate to move inference tooling off public cloud for control-room use cases. Primary ask: fully private VPC + air-gapped on-prem variant (no outbound internet allowed after install).

Key decision makers: CTO (grid-ops), Head of Cybersecurity (compliance), Procurement lead.

Recent timeline:
- 2026-01-18: Intro call (ff_2026-01-18_halcyon_kickoff). Customer: high-level ask, wants full on-prem package. Quote: "Cannot allow egress from primary control plane."
- 2026-02-03: Security questionnaire submitted (customer provided Excel); SE to respond with HSM/KMS details.
- 2026-02-22: Deep dive with security and infra (ff_2026-02-22_sec_review_call). Discussed audit logging retention (5 years), signed integrity checks for shipped artifacts, and offline license activation.
- 2026-02-28: POC hardware spec doc shared. Customer requested 3-node HA, GPUs with NVLink, air-gapped install window (maintenance window: weekends UTC+1).

Use-case & requirements (from discovery):
- Workloads: low-latency control-center chat (SLO 150ms token latency), embeddings for fast document lookup (search p99 < 80ms), reranking pipeline for incident triage (throughput target 150 qps).
- Model preferences: Open LLM family (quantized variants acceptable). Customer wants ability to pin model versions and fast fallback to smaller variants when thermal limits hit.
- Cost sensitivity: medium — will accept dedicated/reserved pricing for predictability.
- Observability: per-request trace, token-level cost breakdown, ability to export audit logs to on-prem SIEM (Splunk).

Security specifics gathered:
- SSO: SAML with Azure AD; SCIM for groups preferred.
- KMS: Must integrate with customer HSM (Luna/HW) via KMIP or an HSM proxy. No external KMS endpoints allowed post-install.
- Audit logging: Immutable append-only logs, retention policy 5 years, periodic CRC checksums for tamper evidence.
- Data residency: All model inputs and logs must stay in EU datacenter and on-prem storage.
- Air-gapped installs: Signed installer images, offline license activation via signed manifests, verified SHA256 manifest checks.

POC plan (high-level):
1) Deliver air-gapped demo package (signed images + install runbook) for dry-run in staging (customer staging is isolated).
2) Run on-prem POC for 4 weeks: validate latency, throughput, and KMS integration. Acceptance criteria: chat token latency p95 < 200ms, embeddings p99 < 100ms, successful HSM-wrapped key operations without outbound network calls.
3) Security sign-off and SOC/compliance checklist completion.

Open/Action items:
- SE (Ravi) to provide detailed HSM integration runbook and sample KMIP configs — due 2026-03-08.
- Legal draft SOW for air-gapped delivery + support SLA (Procurement priority).
- Infra to confirm offline telemetry/metrics approach (how customer pulls metrics to internal Prometheus) — blocker currently.
- Customer to confirm maintenance window for install (target: weekend 2026-04-09).
